map.在浏览器本地用预训练模型(如 MobileNet)对上传图片推理，输出 Top5: Run inference locally in the browser with a pretrained model (such as MobileNet) on the uploaded image and output the top 5 categories with probabilities.
map.纯前端运行，图片不上传，保护隐私且离线可用，适合轻量识别与演示。: Runs purely on the front end with no image uploaded, protecting privacy and working offline; suited to lightweight recognition and demos.

map.：上传一张猫的照片，模型返回 Top5：['Egyptian cat' 0.82: : Upload a photo of a cat and the model returns the top 5: ['Egyptian cat' 0.82, 'tabby' 0.10, ...]. The probability is high but not absolute, and confusable categories (such as different cat breeds) must be judged in context.
